テキスト cha 651: Born Shiyo 758, March 29. Height 159cm (as an adult). Kotaro Niimura's wife, and mother of Chigaya and Kana Niimura. She seems to look like her daughters, but both her eyes are blue. In Shiyo 790 she fell from a cliff near the settlement and died. There are apparently many baffling points about her death; it was thought to be suicide, but when found, her body's head had been cut off.

Just before the Megasawa City affair, she met Mifuyu Niimura and was asked whether the two children bullying Haruka Niimura could be killed, but she admonished her that it was impermissible in every way and did not take it on. Yet according to Mifuyu Niimura, a few days later the items that made the Megasawa City case possible arrived from Sakura. In the end no killing happened in the Shigatsu Arc route, but Mifuyu Niimura confessed it to Erika Niimura. Mifuyu Niimura's view is that Sakura overheard the confession and killed herself out of guilt.

In life, when the cherry blossom season came, she had danger sense. Unlike Natsumi Kogori, though, her power worked not with the wind but when she was in a dark, cramped place.

Like Natsumi Kogori, she apparently came down with the so-called April sickness under the conditions in which her danger sense worked. According to Kotaro Niimura, Sakura Niimura awoke to her danger sense in middle school.
There is a description suggesting that in middle school she held a faint affection for Eiichiro Niimura.

With Kana Niimura, she welcomes Momoko Goto to the Arata settlement. But she is attacked by Kana, who has been struck by murderous intent, and tells Momoko about the curse-killing. Right after holding the body of her husband Kotaro Niimura and speaking words of love to him, she is attacked by residents and dies.

テキスト cha 651: When Chigaya Niimura has her first period, Chigaya gains precognition, and as a side effect turns murderous intent on her. As a solution, she sends Droga and falsificaso to Megasawa City to test how harmful they are to people. As a result, she gives Chigaya falsificaso and treats her Green-Eye Curse-Killing. But like her husband Kotaro Niimura, she is indicted in Shiyo 800.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 651: In Shiyo 801, she touches the sealed Verde mummy and changes into the first of the fourth generation. She tricks the residents into using Droga and schemes to turn the entire settlement into cherry embryos. How she became a mummy (died) is never made clear, but judging from the characters' actions, she was most likely being treated with falsificaso by Mifuyu Niimura, who still had her human self. The most plausible account is that Sakura, back in her right mind, tried to go to the police, but was killed by Eiichiro Niimura before she could escape the settlement.

In middle school, her looks and air make her popular with the boys, but after the gang's boss makes a pass at her, she is badly bullied by the girl then going out with him and her hangers-on. To stop the bullying, Eiichiro Niimura decides to use Droga. She tries to talk him out of it, saying "using Droga is wrong," but he will not listen; in the Droga experiment he is badly hurt, and she is drenched in his blood. Because he broke the rule, and because she could not stop him from breaking it, how Droga and her danger sense began was kept hidden.

Chigaya Niimura gains precognition on having her first period. As a side effect, Chigaya turns murderous intent on her. To solve this, Droga and falsificaso are sent to Megasawa City to test how harmful they are to the human body. But in the end the Megasawa City case never happens, and their safety cannot be confirmed. With Chigaya's strength near its limit, she takes the gamble of giving herself falsificaso and gives up her precognition. As a result, Chigaya Niimura's life is saved. Falsificaso seems to have had no noticeable toxicity.

She meets Haruka Niimura as Haruka tries to escape the Arata settlement, and tells her that she herself is one of the dead, and also that Shigatsu Youka hijacks the senses of precognitives. At this time, though, Shigatsu Youka is busy regenerating Eiichiro Niimura's body and apparently does not notice what Sakura is doing, which, she says, is how she can tell Haruka the truth like this.

Put to work by Shigatsu Youka, which has noticed that Chigaya Niimura is closing in on the truth, she kidnaps Chigaya. Her revived body seems just as it was in life, yet it has a fighting ability no ordinary human could match: it cannot die, and its strength knows no limit. The same goes for Eiichiro Niimura.
